why.body: People-obsessed product thinking. Visceral visual storytelling. And unapologetically culture-led creative. We work across the full creative spectrum. Not for every brand. Just the ones bold enough to mean it.

scrollVideo.eyebrow:
It's easy to say someday. Or worse:
maybe when pigs fly.
scrollVideo.heading:
Why wait for flying pigs,
when we already have flying fish?
scrollVideo.body:
Forget the pig. Still waiting for their ideas to fly. Think fish.
That's what possibility, with wings, actually looks like.

team.heading: Small on Purpose
team.body: Two founders. One studio. No middle-women. Just us. Thinking, making, and sweating the details on everything we touch. We started Flying Fish in the pub, like all the best ideas. Built on the belief that the best creative comes from people who are genuinely invested. In the idea, in the brand, in the outcome.

members.name: Fabiola Caceres Cardenas
members.bio: Faby designs the parts people actually use. She thinks in flows, systems, and the spaces between clicks, making sure every digital experience feels considered rather than cobbled together.

members.name: Rianna Woods
members.bio: The vision person. Start to finish, brief to final build. Rianna leads the creative across every stage: strategy, concept, art direction, execution, shaping how brands look, feel, and show up in the world. The kind of CD who's in it from the first conversation to the last decision.

members.name: Marchello
members.bio: Complaints, concerns, existential crises. Marchello handles them all with the same response: leaning on you until you feel better. He has never once enforced a policy. He has never needed to.

members.name: The Duo
members.bio: They've been working with AI tools long before it became everyone's personality. Midjourney, Firefly, Eleven Labs, Flow. Not as a shortcut. As a craft.
